Welcome to the official YouTube Channel of St. George's University, a globally focused higher education institution with its main campus located in Grenada, West Indies. 

Founded as an independent School of Medicine in 1977, SGU has evolved into a top center of international education, drawing students and faculty from 140 countries. Students enjoy the benefits of a thriving multicultural environment, offering amenities and technologically-advanced facilities.

SGU's nearly 31,000 graduates include physicians, veterinarians, scientists, and public health and business professionals across the world. We offer advanced, pre-med, and pre-vet degrees, and independent and dual graduate degrees in the sciences, public health, and business. Undergraduate degree programs are also available. Programs are accredited and approved by many governing authorities and repeatedly recognized as the best in the region. SGU is also affiliated with educational institutions worldwide.
